name: Evee AI Assistant
author: eveeapp

sections.description:
Evee AI Assistant transforms your WordPress site with an intelligent chat widget powered by RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology. Your AI assistant learns from your website content, documentation, and knowledge base to provide accurate, contextual answers to your visitors.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Chat Widget – Beautiful, customizable chat interface
  • Content Learning – Automatically learns from your WordPress content (posts, pages, custom post types)
  • Intelligent Responses – Provides accurate answers based on your actual content
  • Easy Setup – Just add your Project Slug and Public Key
  • Customizable Appearance – Match your brand with custom colors and positioning
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Privacy Focused – GDPR compliant with clear data handling
  • No Coding Required – Simple point-and-click configuration

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a free account at eveeapp.com
  2. Create a project and add your website content
  3. Install the plugin and enter your credentials
  4. Customize the appearance to match your brand
  5. Activate and start helping visitors!

Perfect For

  • E-commerce Sites – Answer product questions 24/7
  • Documentation Sites – Help users find answers instantly
  • Support Portals – Reduce support ticket volume
  • Business Websites – Engage visitors and capture leads
  • Membership Sites – Provide member support

What is RAG?

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is an advanced AI technique that combines large language models with your specific content. This means your AI assistant:

  • ✅ Answers questions based on YOUR actual content
  • ✅ Provides accurate, up-to-date information
  • ✅ Doesn’t hallucinate or make things up
  • ✅ Continuously learns from your updates

Requirements

  • A free or paid Evee account (Sign up here)
  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

Need help? We’re here for you:

  • 📧 Email: support@eveeapp.com
  • 📚 Documentation: eveeapp.com/docs
  • 💬 Live Chat: Available on our website

Privacy Policy

Evee AI Assistant is GDPR compliant. Chat conversations are sent to Evee’s servers to provide AI responses. We don’t collect personal data without explicit consent. For full details, see our Privacy Policy.

Credits

Developed by the team at Evee.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Evee AI Assistant”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Evee in the WordPress admin menu
  2. Sign up at eveeapp.com if you haven’t already
  3. Enter your Project Slug and Public Key from your Evee dashboard
  4. Enable the widget
  5. (Optional) Customize the appearance to override dashboard settings
  6. Click Save Settings and visit your site to see the widget in action!
sections.faq:
Do I need an Evee account?

Yes, you need a free or paid Evee account. Sign up at eveeapp.com/register.

Is there a free plan?

Yes! Evee offers a free plan perfect for getting started. Paid plans offer more features and higher usage limits.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously and doesn’t impact your page load times. It’s optimized for performance.

What data does the plugin collect?

The plugin only sends chat conversations to Evee’s servers to provide AI responses. We don’t collect any personal data without consent. See our Privacy Policy.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes! You can customize colors, position, welcome message, and more from the settings page.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes! The widget works with all major page builders including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and others.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Each WordPress site requires its own project in your Evee account. All plans support multiple projects.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The widget is fully responsive and works perfectly on mobile devices.

How do I get support?

Email us at support@eveeapp.com or use the live chat on eveeapp.com.
